workstream: HTTP multi-instance PostgreSQL session and realtime boundary
gap: The repository had PostgreSQL pool and LISTEN/NOTIFY evidence, but no public HTTP proof spanning two independently started application processes.
hypothesis: Two independent Next processes sharing one disposable PostgreSQL can authenticate the same session across processes and deliver a committed, scope-filtered outbox event to an SSE stream through LISTEN/NOTIFY without putting clinical data in the notification payload.
expected_value: This closes the largest locally actionable gap between service-level multi-instance tests and the public HTTP/SSE boundary while preserving the distinction between synthetic evidence and production acceptance.
estimated_cost: One disposable PostgreSQL cluster, two bounded Next development child processes, one focused test, the full PostgreSQL regression suite, lint/type checks, documentation reconciliation and one fresh critic attempt.

change.summary: Integrate the two-process HTTP test harness, cross-instance session/SSE scenario and conditional evidence into the current candidate.

evidence.environment: Disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 on loopback; two Next.js 16.3.0 development processes; Node 22; synthetic fixture; distinct ports, dist directories, storage roots and application names.
evidence.outcome: Dedicated HTTP scenario passed 1/1 in 2.826s; login A/session B, pg_stat_activity LISTEN proof, no-clinical-payload probe, mutation A and authorized SSE event B all passed.

evidence.environment: Fresh disposable PostgreSQL 16.15 cluster on loopback; complete Vitest PostgreSQL integration configuration; cluster stopped after execution and pre-existing 5432 listener untouched.
evidence.outcome: Full PostgreSQL suite passed 5 files and 23/23 tests in 11.34s.

evidence.command: Fresh read-only critic against the sealed HTTP packet and fingerprint 026f38e00868c0a476d3b9324f58c3b41081aa0b95fa5482133321fe03071dec
evidence.environment: Independent context; no filesystem mutation; critic was given the packet, source paths and explicit local-vs-production limits.
evidence.outcome: No report arrived in three 30-second wait windows; agent was closed and no approval inferred. Mutation sentinel is clean because the artifact fingerprint remained unchanged.

retest: npm run typecheck; npm run lint; npm run validate:docs; git diff --check; full PostgreSQL suite 23/23; JSON/control-plane parse and engineering-framework checker.

critic.mechanism: Fresh non-inherited context with a sealed packet and explicit read-only/no-mutation instruction.
critic.largest_gap: The independent critic did not produce a report within 90 seconds; target next-start/production, reconnect/replay, representative-load, cutover and human gates remain open.

next_gap: Fresh independent review and target-equivalent next-start validation of multi-instance session/realtime behavior, followed by representative load, reconnect/replay, relational cutover, operations and human policy gates.
